title: Inverted ratio guard blocks legitimate de-risking of an unhealthy account (liveness/DoS) [MERGED INTO F-1]
root_cause: checkValidTransition reverts when the value/risk ratio improves, so an under-margin account cannot reduce its position to recover unless it reaches full health in one step.
attacker_entrypoint: Any de-risking trade/deleverage on an under-margin account (routes through checkValidTransition)
attacker_capabilities: attempt a partial close (typical partial orderbook fill)

severity_justification.worst_case: Underwater accounts cannot self-heal => forced deeper into liquidation/insolvency.
severity_justification.realistic_case: With partial fills, incremental recovery is blocked; combines with F-1.
severity_justification.program_table_mapping: see official program impact table (not bundled)

bounty_program_mapping.scope_reference: TipRun contest (tiprun-contracts-main @ d5d4d2a); official scope list not bundled with PoC package.

call_trace: reach an under-margin account (collateral 2000 / long 5000) via F-1
attempt a fair partial de-risk: sell 500 synthetic for 500 collateral (risk down, still under margin)
reverts 'PM: val/risk dec' — only a full de-risk to health is allowed

state_transition.after: partial de-risk reverts; position unchanged at 5000

asset_delta: No direct loss; positions can be stranded under margin (cannot recover incrementally).

defense_analysis.why_it_fails: reduction passes that check but is then reverted by the inverted ratio guard
